How to Create a Dynamic Dashboard in Odoo 19 (Step by Step)

This tutorial shows how to create a Dynamic Dashboard in Odoo using Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI. You can generate boards with AI, start from templates, or design widgets manually.

Before you start

  • Odoo 19 on Community, Enterprise (on-premise), or Odoo.sh
  • Admin rights to install apps
  • (Optional) Your own AI provider API key if you want AI generation

Step 1 — Install the Odoo Dashboard app

  1. Open Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI on the Apps Store and purchase/download for 19.0.
  2. Add the module to your addons path (or install via your Odoo.sh / deployment flow).
  3. Update the Apps list and install Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI.
Tip: Sample Sales, Purchase, Inventory, or Accounting boards appear when those apps are already installed. The Dashboard module itself does not require them.

Step 2 — Create your first Dynamic Dashboard

Pick one of three paths:

Option A — Ready-made examples

Open the Dashboard app and explore demo boards (Sales, CRM, Inventory, Accounting, HR, Project). Duplicate a board and adapt filters to your company.

Option B — AI generation

  1. Go to Settings and add your AI provider API key (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Cursor, or compatible endpoint).
  2. Choose generate by model or by keyword (for example “Sales”, “Pipeline”, “Overdue invoices”).
  3. Preview suggested widgets, keep what you need, then save.

Option C — Drag-and-drop Dashboard Builder

Create a blank board, add tiles/charts/lists, bind each widget to an Odoo model or query, then arrange the layout.

Step 3 — Connect the right data

  • Odoo models for standard ERP metrics
  • Custom SQL or Visual Query Builder for joins and custom aggregations
  • Excel / CSV / Google Sheets for side datasets
  • APIs / PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQL Server for external systems

Step 4 — Add KPIs, filters, and targets

  1. Create KPI tiles for headline numbers (revenue, overdue AR, on-hand stock).
  2. Add date filters and domains so users can switch “This Month” vs “This Quarter”.
  3. Set targets and alerts when achievement drifts.
  4. Enable drill-down so a chart click opens underlying records.

Step 5 — Share, export, or put it on TV

  • Share a secure link with the right users
  • Export PNG, PDF, Excel, or CSV
  • Schedule email reports for Monday morning packs
  • Use TV Mode to rotate boards on office screens

Example: Sales Dashboard in 10 minutes

  1. Generate with keyword “Sales” (or duplicate the Sales example board).
  2. Keep tiles for Revenue, Orders, Win Rate.
  3. Add a monthly bar/line for revenue vs target.
  4. Add a funnel for quotation stages and a list of top orders.
  5. Filter by company/sales team and pin the board to your menu favorites.

Troubleshooting

  • No sample board for Accounting? Install Accounting first, then refresh demos.
  • AI returns nothing? Check the API key, provider endpoint, and that AI is enabled in Settings. Boards still work without AI.
  • Empty chart? Verify the model domain, date field, and that demo/real records exist.
